name: Insight Timer
one_liner: Insight Timer is a free meditation app with over 150,000 guided meditations, music tracks, and courses from thousands of teachers worldwide.
best_for: Those who like variety in teachers and styles
People interested in community and live events
not_for: Those in crisis needing immediate care (call 988)
People seeking clinical mental health treatment
Those preferring polished, curated apps like Calm
short_description: Insight Timer is a free meditation app with over 150,000 guided meditations, music tracks, and courses from thousands of teachers worldwide.
long_description: Insight Timer is the world's largest free meditation library, offering over 150,000 guided meditations, music tracks, ambient sounds, and courses from 10,000+ teachers. The app is free with optional premium membership. Features include a meditation timer, progress tracking, community groups, and live events. Content covers mindfulness, sleep, stress, anxiety, and personal growth. Unlike subscription-focused competitors, Insight Timer's model keeps most content free while premium unlocks additional features. The global community aspect connects millions of meditators worldwide.
patient_summary: Insight Timer is like a library of guided meditations. Find meditations for sleep, anxiety, trauma, or anything else you're working on. Most content is free, and there are thousands of teachers to explore.

pricing.notes: Most content free. Premium adds features.

privacy.notes: Consumer app, not healthcare. Review privacy policy.

faqs.a: Yes, Insight Timer's core offering is free—over 150,000 meditations, music tracks, and courses. Premium membership (~$60/year) adds offline listening, advanced features, and courses, but most users find the free version sufficient.

faqs.q: How is Insight Timer different from Calm or Headspace?
faqs.a: Insight Timer offers vastly more free content from thousands of teachers, while Calm and Headspace have smaller, more curated libraries behind paywalls. Insight Timer has more variety but less polish. Try all three to find your preference.

faqs.q: What content does Insight Timer offer?
faqs.a: Guided meditations across all styles, sleep music, ambient sounds, meditation courses, talks on mindfulness and personal growth, and live community events. Content ranges from 1 minute to multi-hour.

faqs.q: Is Insight Timer good for beginners?
faqs.a: Yes, Insight Timer has extensive beginner content. However, the sheer volume can be overwhelming. Use collections, teacher filtering, or their beginner courses to navigate. Many prefer simpler apps initially.
